title: Anyone remember Lego Loco? I created something similar with Claude
author: Vigomoz
selftext:
As a kid I played a ton of Lego Loco, a simple, casual game where you could build a town and some trains and watch it all come to life. So for my own daughter, I tried to recreate something that captures that vibe. She’s having a blast with it, so I thought I’d share it.



The game is free, with a paid option if you want more than one city. As a bonus, I added the Lego Loco postcard feature, which lets you send mail to other players. For that you’ll need an account (also free).



Let me know what you think!



iOS: [https://apps.apple.com/app/id6777207688](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6777207688)



Google: [https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=ios.ohhi.nl.tinkertown](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=ios.ohhi.nl.tinkertown)



It was made with Claude Code (code, assets, video's, appstore screenshots) and Sona for the music.
